public_assets.purpose: Find tickets control, reservation view and timer rendering
Reservation actions, SDK handoff and response normalizers

source_call_chain.observation: The enabled quantity/type path dispatches module 45064 export Pd, locally named H.
Information, non-adjacent-seat and accessibility dialogs can precede RESERVE_START. The action then enters SDK or platform-specific reservation processing.

The MFOL branch can invoke module 38136 export YR, which calls CheckoutSDK.checkout with selected ticket types, quantities, price filters and section filters. The fallback invokes module 6864 export ru.

The legacy MFOL reservation helper uses an authenticated POST. An OK response supplies a redirect link; NO_AVAILABILITY_ERROR and non-adjacent/block-size errors use separate paths. No request was made during this review.
BIGGEST_SEAT_BLOCK_ERROR, NON_ADJACENT_SEATS_REQUIRED_ERROR and one SDK error path can open the acceptNonAdjacent dialog after reservation processing begins.

source_call_chain.location: chunk 9757: module 45064 and event page timer component
source_call_chain.observation: Some successful response branches dispatch TIMER_START when normalized response.timer exists. The event page can render the translated reservation timer. These branches do not prove that this Czech event currently uses that view.

reservation_boundary.journal_requirement: Persist the attempt and dispatch marker before activating Find tickets. A dialog, timeout or navigation alone cannot establish a hold or a safe retry.

static_response_candidates.limitation: Only the event-to-checkout handoff is described here. No actual Czech checkout receipt, complete price, seat group or hold expiry was captured.
Static support for another checkout response shape; applicability to this Czech flow and complete checkout fee coverage are unverified. Exact match is not promoted to adjacency.
No actual response observed. A ticket unit price does not establish the complete fee-inclusive group total.
Separate platform branch; do not implement a Czech receipt parser from these names. The code supports alternate-date results, so a later receipt must bind the actual event date.
